objective: Promote, version, and bind the existing directional-lab causal market-data foundation so GATE22+ can consume historically replayable, provenance-bound, leakage-safe, FREE, path-independent data without rebuilding DailyBarV1 or lab macro vintage semantics.
strategicPurpose: Make market data historically reproducible, provenance-bound and safe for downstream causal features and decisions by promoting existing lab contracts rather than recreating them.

historicalVsLiveBoundary.historical: GATE21 snapshots, vintages, manifests and replay
historicalVsLiveBoundary.live: Yahoo / existing IBKR python shadow remain the production live plane; GATE21 must not implement, replace or dual-fetch live
historicalVsLiveBoundary.rule: A live quote must never be substituted into a historical snapshot

dataSourceRegistryRequirements.rule: Do not invent a parallel source registry.

sourcePriorityAndFallback.rule: Declared ordered fallback per series. Contradiction is fail-closed or explicit DEGRADED, never a silent pick. Fallback must not introduce a later vintage or live-into-historical substitution. Missing fallback for a required source blocks closure.

eventTimeVsAvailableAt.rule: Promote DailyBarV1: eventTime is the session event; availableAt is the first usable instant; availableAt >= eventTime is mandatory. GATE21 tests this invariant and does not redefine it.

dataRevisionVintageSemantics.rule: Promote existing lab L4B vintage set, observation vintage, resolveMacroVintageAsOf and dataset snapshot identity. Historical replay of revisable macro series must use the vintage available at T, not a later revision. GATE21 must not rebuild these modules.
dataRevisionVintageSemantics.hostileTest: Fixture where a revision at T+n differs; as-of T must not observe T+n.

rawVsAdjustedSemantics.rule: Promote DATA_CONTRACT bases stored separately with no implicit mix. DERIVED_ADJUSTED is refused in strict mode. GATE21 does not invent a fifth basis.

corporateActions.rule: Promote corporateActionV1, corporateActionPolicy and TEMPORAL_RULES intra-session order. Splits and dividends are never forward-filled into prices. Ambiguous same-session RAW split+dividend fails closed. GATE21 tests existing policy and does not rewrite it.

marketCalendarSessionTimezone.rule: Promote civilDate (UTC civil YYYY-MM-DD, no local Date conversion) and marketCalendarL3V1. America/New_York session rules already in DailyBarV1. GATE21 binds them and does not replace them.

missingness.rule: Promote missingReasonsV1: null stays null; missing volume is never silently 0; no forward-fill; a rolling window containing null produces null. Unknown reasons are refused.

provenance.rule: Every snapshot, bar and vintage binds source identity, loader/version and hashes as the lab already does. GATE21 evidence recomputes identities from bytes and never trusts an asserted PASS.

replayableSnapshotManifest.rule: Promote DatasetManifestV1, SnapshotDatasetManifestV1 and validateDatasetManifest hash verification. Closure rematerializes from bound inputs to a byte-identical digest. available is not complete. An empty dataset is not complete.

mustFail: future suffix after T used at T
later macro vintage used at T
leakageProof.rule: Evidence is failing hostile tests plus passing replay. Presence of a leakage document is not closure.

schemaVersioning.rule: Named schema versions remain (DailyBarV1, vintage L4B, manifests). Evolution is additive. Consumers ignore unknown fields. Removing or renaming a required field requires a version bump and migration. GATE21 pins promoted versions and does not freeze them irreversibly.

exactNewGap: GATE21-governed binding of existing lab identities: source registry/fallback/FREE records, leakage and vintage-hindsight closure evidence pack, schema/version pins, portability root resolution for new artifacts, hygiene manifests for GATE21 test workspaces, and a real consumer-proof fixture. Files on disk alone cannot close GATE21. If lab APIs already satisfy a binding, do not duplicate.
primaryProducer: directional-lab causal contracts plus GATE21 binding and evidence wrappers under governance/gates/GATE21/ when later separately write-granted
primaryConsumers: GATE32 leakage/OOS validation (not a GATE21 producer)

portabilityAndMigrationThinContract.gate21Scope: New GATE21 artifacts resolve through configurable roots. No new machine-home hardcodes. Constitution canonicalPath remains MACHINE_SPECIFIC and is not amended in GATE21. Full EXPORT/RESTORE/SMOKE remains GATE40.

freeDataSourcePolicyThinContract.rule: Required GATE21 sources have COST_CLASS=FREE. No paid API, dataset, licence or mandatory paid tier. If a series is not FREE-reliable it is omitted from required V1 or marked UNAVAILABLE; it is not fabricated.

storageHygieneThinContract.rule: GATE21 tests and runners that allocate Temp reuse run-root-lifecycle. Historical Temp leftovers are not cleaned in GATE21.

noProductionCouplingProof.rule: Must remain PASS and be recomputed at closure. A comment is insufficient. Scanner paths are excluded from the workset.

exactWorkset.consumeExisting: existingAssetsToReuse plus existing lab tests: no-production-coupling, temporal-causality, split-adjustment, manifest-coverage, snapshot-dataset-manifest, market-macro-l4b-i1/i2 vintage tests
laterCreateNotAuthorizedByThisMandate: GATE21 implementation, tests and evidence under governance/gates/GATE21/
exactWorkset.laterModifyLabDefault: Do not modify DailyBarV1 or vintage modules; wrap unless a proven binding bug exists.

forbiddenPaths: G23 family contracts (seasonality, technical, volume-structure, macro feature publication, earnings feature, regime snapshot, featureSnapshot, order/trade/fill/signal/backtestResult)

closurePathProof.rule: GATE21 cannot close because files exist. Closure must recalculate from bound bytes: real consumer fixture; causality; replay digest identity; leakage and vintage-hindsight hostile tests; FREE_DATA registry rows for required sources; portability replay under a different DATA_ROOT; STORAGE_HYGIENE ephemeral root released or locked failure recorded; no-production-coupling PASS; live-scan workset empty; evolvability tests PASS; validator-derived verdict with no asserted PASS field.

futureChangeTest: Without reopening closed GATE21 evidence: add a FREE source; add an additive field; pin schema v2; pin vintage v2; rollback to v1; migrate snapshot format; rebind DATA_ROOT.
future3GatesTest: GATE22 new label class, GATE23 new feature family consuming v1 bars/vintages, and GATE24 regime vector reading GATE23 which reads GATE21 must work against frozen GATE21 v1 without reopening GATE21, self-bootstrap or a new trust root.
future10GatesSanityCheck: The GATE21 data plane remains extensible to GATE31+ via versioning and adapters. A later provider is a source-registry adapter, not a GATE21 reopen. A later UI replacement must not require a GATE21 rebuild.
rollbackOrFallback: Rollback pins the previous schema/snapshot version. Fallback is lab research-only unchanged and Wheel live unchanged if GATE21 bindings are absent.
migrationAndDeprecationPath: Migrate by rematerializing snapshots under the new version while keeping old manifests readable. Deprecate by version id, never by silently rewriting DailyBarV1 or deleting closed evidence.
mergeReadiness: ISOLATED. Not UI_LAB. Not INTEGRATION_CANDIDATE. Not REMOTE_ELIGIBLE. BUILD PASS is not merge permission. No ui-lab refresh in GATE21.
precontractExpectation: A later separate Owner write-grant is required to issue precontract via existing issue-precontract-authority.mjs. This mandate does not authorize precontract, START or BUILD.
startPreconditions: EXACT_WORKSET locked in an execution contract
completeConfirmedCriteria: Causality, vintage-hindsight, replay, leakage, FREE_DATA, portability, hygiene, zero coupling, zero scan-latency delta and evolvability are evidenced
Independent confirmation remains a later separate session
requiredOutputs: causal market-data binding of existing lab contracts
source and provenance registry referencing lab identities
missing-data and leakage-control report including vintage-hindsight
real consumer-proof that GATE21 bindings are actually consumed
exitConditions: Every required market-data source is identity- and provenance-bound with COST_CLASS=FREE.
Event time is distinct from real availability time and availableAt >= eventTime.
Missing data is explicit and cannot silently become observed data.
Historical snapshots rematerialize to a byte-identical digest.
Known future leakage and later-vintage hindsight tests are rejected.
A declared consumer fixture fails if GATE21 v1 bindings disappear or mismatch.
no-production-coupling remains PASS and Wheel live-scan files are absent from the workset.
New GATE21 artifacts are path-independent and GATE21 ephemeral test roots are declared and cleaned or recorded failed.
This mandate did not START, BUILD, or auto-authorize GATE22.
No unrelated regression identity is introduced.
forbiddenScope: START or BUILD by this document
downstreamGuarantees: GATE22-GATE40 may consume only causal, as-of-bound data products promoted by GATE21.
This mandate creates no execution contract, START, state transition or implementation.
